DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 植え込みについて何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the planted shrubs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤い実があるので、料理に使う実だと思いました。少し摘んで持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 植え込みの実を食用と思い採取可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are red berries, so I thought they were used in cooking. Can I pick a few to take home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the shrubs' berries were edible and ask about picking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た目だけで食べられるか判断しないでください。ここは採取用の植え込みでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not judge edibility from appearance alone. These plantings are not for harvesting either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ摘んでいません。名前が分からない物を味見して確かめることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未採取で味見による判断もしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not picked any. I will not taste something unidentified to find out either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not picked any and will not judge by tasting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。観察はできますが、枝や実を取らずにご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. You may observe, but do not take branches or berries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもが興味を持っています。触らせず、離れた所から写真を撮るだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもを触らせず観察だけにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child is interested. I will not let them touch it; we will only take photos from a distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not let your child touch it; just observe. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 植物について調べる場合も、写真だけで食用と決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even when researching plants, do not decide they are edible based only on photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。料理用は売場で食品として販売された物を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真だけで食用と決めず食品売場で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. For cooking, I will choose things sold as food in a shop's food department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not decide edibility from photos and will choose from food shops. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。公園の植物はそのまま残しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Let's leave the park plants as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。実を取らず、子どもにも持ち帰るための物ではないと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採取せず子どもへ用途の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not pick the berries and will explain to my child that they are not for taking home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not harvest and explain the difference in purpose to your child. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。観察のあとは通路へ戻り、公園の案内に従ってお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. After observing, return to the path and follow the park guidance during your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の時刻をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking up train times?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人から十時と聞いたので、十時にここを出る列車を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十時を発車時刻と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend said ten o'clock, so I am looking for a train leaving here at ten.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you thought ten was the departure time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メッセージは発車時刻ですか。それとも目的地で会う時刻でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the message mean departure time or the time to meet at your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「十時に港駅で会おう」とあります。ここを出る時刻ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の文面から待ち合わせの到着時刻だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “Let's meet at Port Station at ten.” It was not the time to leave here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct from the message that ten is the meeting arrival time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では港駅へ十時に着く便を調べる必要があります。現在の時刻から確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we need a service arriving at Port Station at ten. Let's check based on the current time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。十時着が間に合わない場合は、友人に遅れると伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着に間に合う便の有無を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If I cannot arrive at ten, I want to tell my friend I will be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether a service can arrive in time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では十時までに着く便はもうありません。次の便の到着予定をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation, no remaining service gets there by ten. We will give the next service's expected arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。出発時刻だけでなく到着予定を聞き、友人の返事も確認してから券を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着予定を聞き友人の返事まで購入を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will ask arrival time as well as departure, and wait for my friend's reply before buying a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask arrival time and wait for your friend's reply before buying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の便は十時半着の予定です。実際の運行状況も表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next service is scheduled to arrive at ten-thirty. Check the actual operating status on the display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が十時半に変更できると言いました。その便の行き先と運行表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待ち合わせ変更後に便の行き先と運行を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend said we can change to ten-thirty. I will check that service's destination and operating display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After changing the meeting, check destination and service status. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回は港駅への到着を基準に、券と列車をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. This time we will guide you on the ticket and train based on arrival at Port Station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほど別の窓口でもお申し込みされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you also apply at another counter earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。担当が分からず、同じ住まいの相談を二つの窓口に書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ相談を二窓口に申し込んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I did not know who was responsible and wrote the same housing consultation at two counters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you applied at two counters for the same consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つは別の相談ですか。それとも同じ状況の説明でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are these separate matters, or explanations of the same situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じです。二回申し込めば早くなると思ったわけではなく、どちらかが担当かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別件ではなく担当不明で重複したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The same. I did not think applying twice would speed it up; I thought one might be the responsible desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain duplication came from uncertainty about responsibility, not separate matters. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。申込内容を確認し、必要な担当への引き継ぎを整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will check the applications and organize handover to the needed staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。片方だけ違う住所を書いてしまったので、正しい住所も同時に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一方の住所の誤りも訂正したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I wrote a different address on just one, so I want to give the correct address at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the address error on one application too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正する住所はどちらの控えか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know which copy needs the address correction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い控えの方です。もう一方は正しいです。自分で片方を捨てず、二枚とも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えを区別し両方残して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The blue one. The other is correct. I will show both rather than discard one myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the copies and preserve both to show. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当者が重複と訂正を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Staff will check duplication and correction and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。同じ相談だと説明し、担当と申込みの扱いが分かるまで新たに申し込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複整理まで新規申込みを増やさないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain it is the same consultation and make no new application until I understand the responsible desk and how the applications are handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to add applications until duplication is sorted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二枚の控えをお預かりし、相談の整理担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will take both copies and hand them to the consultation coordinating staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは病院までの道の地図でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a map showing the way to the hospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 違います。頭が痛くなった場所と時間を書いたメモです。道を聞きたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参メモが道案内ではなく症状の経過だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. It is a note of the places and times my headache started. I am not asking directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct that your note is symptom history, not directions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状の経過のメモですね。丸印は場所を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: A symptom-history note. Do the circles indicate places?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、会社と自宅です。ただ、どちらでも同じ痛みかは、うまく言葉にできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所の印と説明が難しい範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, work and home. But I cannot describe well whether it was the same pain at both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show what the place marks mean and what is hard to explain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に同じとまとめず、分かる範囲で担当者に説明しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not force them together as the same; explain what you can to the clinician.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社では午後、自宅では夜に気づきました。原因が場所にあるとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所と時間を述べ原因を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed it at work in the afternoon and at home at night. I cannot say the place caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State places and times without asserting a cause. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その時刻と場所の情報を伝えます。メモを診療担当者へ見せてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will pass on those times and places. May we show the note to the clinician?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の説明を助ける物として見せてください。地図だけで診断を決めてもらうつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メモを本人説明の補助として診療担当者へ見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Show it as something supporting my explanation. I do not expect diagnosis from a map alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to show the note to the clinician as support for your own explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。メモにない変化も、担当者の質問に答えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Also answer their questions about changes not in the note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。分からない所は分からないと伝え、このメモと一緒に自分で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明点を推測せずメモと自分の説明を併用する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will say when I do not know and explain in person with this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not guess unknowns; use the note with your own explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、症状の経過を補うメモとして、診療担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will pass it to the clinician as a note supplementing symptom history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前、オンラインでご相談されましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この画面を開いて内容を打ったので、もう届け出たと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入力画面を見せ受付済みだと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I opened this screen and typed the details, so I think I have already filed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the entry screen and explain you thought it was accepted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送信後の受付番号や完了の表示は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you check a reception number or completion display after sending?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。下書きの画面が残っていて、送信ボタンも押したか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 完了表示がなく送信操作も不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The draft screen remains, and I do not remember whether I pressed Send.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is no completion display and you do not know if you sent it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 閲覧や入力だけと、正式に受け付けられたことは別です。今回の内容を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Viewing or entering details differs from formal acceptance. Staff will check this matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。二重に届けたのか、まだ届いていないのか分からないことも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二重受付か未受付か分からないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I also want to explain I do not know whether it is duplicated or not yet received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about not knowing whether acceptance is duplicated or absent. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。画面のサイト名と、入力した時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Do you know the site name on the screen and when you entered it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: サイト名はここにあります。昨夜の九時ごろです。今ここで勝手に再送信せず、画面を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: サイト名と入力時刻を示し再送を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The site name is here. Around nine last night. I will show the screen without resending it on my own here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show site name and entry time and hold off resending. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付の扱いと相談方法を担当者へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let's check acceptance handling and consultation methods with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。下書きを残したまま、既存の受付記録と今回の相談を整理してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 下書きを残し受付記録の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will keep the draft and have existing acceptance records and this consultation organized.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the draft and request acceptance-record verification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。オンラインの受付未確認として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We will pass this to staff as unconfirmed online acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その番号は、配送の番号でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that number a shipping number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買った時の番号です。注文が確定したので、これで郵便の状況も分かると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文番号で配送状況を見られると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The number from when I bought it. The order was confirmed, so I thought it would also show postal status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you thought the order number would show delivery status. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文番号と郵便の追跡番号は別です。発送の連絡は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Order numbers and postal tracking numbers differ. Have you received a dispatch notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「注文受付」の連絡だけです。「発送」の連絡があるかはまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送連絡をまだ確認していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only an order-received notice. I have not checked whether there is a dispatch message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked the dispatch notice yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 販売元の発送案内から、配送会社と番号を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the carrier and number from the seller's dispatch information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。郵便で送られたと決めず、メールと注文画面を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配送会社も含め発送案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will look at email and the order screen without assuming it was sent by post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check dispatch information including the carrier. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 販売元の確認が必要な場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may also need to check with the seller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メールにはまだ準備中とあります。配送番号がないので、販売元へ発送予定を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備中と分かり販売元へ予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The email still says preparing. There is no shipping number, so I will ask the seller the planned dispatch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Realize it is preparing and ask the seller about plans. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。ここで未発送の注文の状況を確定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. We cannot establish an unshipped order's status here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。注文の受付と発送を分け、配送会社と番号が分かってから必要な照会をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注文受付と発送を区別し適切な番号で照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will distinguish order acceptance from dispatch and make any needed inquiry once I know the carrier and number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish order acceptance and dispatch and inquire with the right number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日は注文元への確認をご案内し、配達照会は進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Today we will direct you to the seller and will not proceed with a delivery inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金額はこちらの五千円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The deposit amount is five thousand yen here, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 数えた時は五千円でしたが、ここへ来る前に交通費を取り分けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集計後に交通費を抜いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was five thousand when I counted, but before coming I set aside travel expenses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you removed travel money after totaling. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それでは今お預けになる金額は違うかもしれません。取り分けた額は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then the amount you are depositing now may differ. Do you know how much you set aside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三百円のつもりでしたが、急いだので確かではありません。差し引きだけで決めたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取り分け額が不確かで単純計算を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I intended three hundred yen, but I was rushed and am not sure. I do not want to decide just by subtracting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the set-aside amount is uncertain and you want to avoid simple calculation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在お持ちの入金分を確認しましょう。取り分けた財布とは分かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the deposit money you have now. Is it separate from the wallet where you put travel money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入金分はこの袋、交通費は財布です。財布のお金まで混ぜないで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入金袋と財布を分け確認対象を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Deposit money is in this bag, travel money in my wallet. I want to check without mixing wallet money in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the deposit bag and wallet and specify what to check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋の中の金額を確認し、申込額の訂正方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will check the bag amount and explain correcting the application amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。元の集計表は消さず、取り分けた後に金額を変えたことを記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の集計を残し金額変更の経緯を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will not erase the original tally; I will record that the amount changed after setting money aside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Preserve the original tally and record why the amount changed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。現在の金額が確定してから入金の意思を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will confirm your wish to deposit once the current amount is established.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。元の五千円ではなく、袋にある確認済みの額を預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物確認後の金額で入金すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will deposit the verified amount in the bag rather than the original five thousand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to deposit the amount verified against actual cash. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず入金用の袋だけを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we will check only the deposit bag and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をお探しでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was this the product you were looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき試食しておいしかったので、この箱を選びました。同じ物ですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食の品と取った箱が同じか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I liked the sample earlier, so I chose this box. It is the same, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the sample and selected box are the same. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試食はしょうゆ味、こちらの箱は塩味です。近くにありますが別の商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sample was soy sauce flavor; this box is salt flavor. They are nearby but different products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ色の箱だったので迷いました。試食した味の名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見た目で選んだことを説明し味の名前を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The boxes were the same color, so I got confused. What is the name of the flavor I sampled?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you chose by appearance and ask the flavor name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 「しょうゆせんべい」です。こちらの札に商品名があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Soy sauce rice crackers. The product name is on this sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。しょうゆ味の箱に替えたいです。今の箱はまだ会計していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未会計の商品を試食した味へ交換したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I want to switch to a soy sauce box. I have not paid for this box yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to exchange an unpaid item for the sampled flavor. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。スタッフが元の場所へ戻します。こちらがしょうゆ味です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Staff will return it to its place. Here is soy sauce flavor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これですね。詰め合わせではなく、全部しょうゆ味かも表示で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単一味か詰め合わせか内容表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one, right? I also want to check whether it is all soy sauce rather than an assortment on the contents label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether the contents are one flavor or an assortment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この箱はしょうゆ味だけです。表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This box contains only soy sauce flavor. Please check the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。試食の印象だけでなく、名前と内容を見てこちらを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名と内容を確認して購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked. I will buy this after looking at the name and contents, not just my impression of the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check product name and contents and decide to buy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。しょうゆ味の箱一つで会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ring up one soy sauce flavor box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチについてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 人の名前が書いてあるので、その人の予約席だと思いました。座らない方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名札を予約席だと思い利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: A person's name is written on it, so I thought it was reserved for them. Should I avoid sitting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the nameplate meant reserved seating and ask whether you may use it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では、寄贈者を示す札です。予約席の表示ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, the plaque names the donor. It is not a reservation sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寄贈した人の名前なんですね。名前があることと、今日の利用者が決まっていることは別でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 寄贈者名と当日の予約表示を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The donor's name, then. Having a name and having today's user decided are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish a donor name from today's reservation sign. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。一般のベンチとして使えますが、ほかの利用者とも譲り合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. It is a public bench, but share it with other users.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物を横に並べて一人で全部使わず、空きを残して座ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物で全体を占有しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not spread bags beside me and use the whole bench alone; I will leave room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not occupy the whole bench with bags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。利用中の人がいれば、その場で声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. If someone is using it, ask them there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は一人座っています。隣が空いているか聞いてから、座ろうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存の利用者に空席を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: One person is seated now. I will ask whether the space beside them is free before sitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to check the empty space with the existing user. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。札を外したり隠したりする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. There is no need to remove or cover the plaque.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。名札はそのままにして、先に座っている人と相談して使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を変えず利用者と相談して使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will leave the nameplate as it is and discuss using it with the person seated first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use it after asking the user without altering the plaque. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一般のベンチとして、譲り合ってご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please share it as a public bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの乗り換えをご利用ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内です。徒歩七分とありますが、改札の中を歩くんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩区間が駅構内か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This guidance. It says seven minutes on foot; is that walking inside the ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the walking section is inside the station. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では別の駅まで外を歩く区間です。同じ駅のホーム移動ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here it means walking outside to another station, not between platforms in the same station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外へ出るんですね。今の券で改札を出て、次の駅でもそのまま使えるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別駅への移動と現在の券の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I go outside. I want to check whether I can exit with my current ticket and use it as it is at the next station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm movement to another station and current-ticket handling. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の区間と種類を係員が確認します。地図だけでは券の扱いは決まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check the ticket's coverage and type. A map alone does not determine ticket handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。券を見せます。外の道は、この案内の点線の部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券を提示し徒歩経路を地図で特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will show the ticket. Is the outdoor route the dotted part of this map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present the ticket and identify the walking route on the map. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。歩行者用の経路をご案内します。線路沿いに近道できるとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will guide you along the pedestrian route. Do not assume you can shortcut along the tracks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 雨が強いので、歩く経路を確認してから友人に合流が遅れるか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 天候による時間変化を友人へ伝える予定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is raining hard, so after checking the walking route I will tell my friend whether I will be late meeting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your plan to tell your friend about weather-related timing changes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券の確認後、外の移動が難しければ別経路も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the ticket check, if outdoor movement is difficult you can discuss another route too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まず券の扱いと徒歩の道を聞き、移動方法を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券と経路を確認後に移動方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. First I will ask about the ticket and walking path, then choose how to travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose travel method after checking ticket and route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。券の確認担当へご案内し、徒歩の経路図もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will guide you to ticket-checking staff and give you a walking-route map too.
